codex has hard stops: Sections 5 and 6 of sha256:72b466d84f21756fcd9c0d7528354c6e0c18b0f0db4464e280225b9e58dba8d1 are mutually unsatisfiable: the re-weave records input HEAD A, but committing that generated evidence in the required same PR creates HEAD B; authoritative verification then requires A == B.
